audit_items.proof_trace: handle_withdraw first removes ctokens from the obligation (L328 withdraw_ctokens), then calls is_obligation_safe on the already-reduced state (L332-342), and asserts the result. Move/Sui transaction atomicity guarantees that if the assert fails the entire state change reverts, so the obligation can never be committed post-withdrawal in an unsafe state. All public withdraw entry points route through handle_withdraw with no bypass path.
